name: Boostic R
description: Back based on demand from the most technically proficient climbers. The Boostic is SCARPA's stiffest high-performance shoe for unmatched edging power and precision on the tiniest features. Features V-Tension Rand and full-length Vibram XS Edge outsole for ultimate support and micro-edging precision.
use_case: Technical bouldering, sport climbing, precision edging

name: Chimera
description: A highly technical slipper for advanced climbers demanding maximum sensitivity and precision on overhanging routes.

name: Drago XT
description: The Drago XT adds a more powerful option to the Drago family. Dual Velcro straps for super secure fit and precision. PCB Tension delivers flexible power, full coverage rubber heel is laser etched with texture for ultimate heel hooking ability.
use_case: Steep overhanging climbing, heel hooking, sport climbing

name: Drago
description: A precise, aggressive climbing slipper ideal for overhanging routes and bouldering. Velcro closure for quick adjustments.

name: Drago LV
description: Low-volume version of the Drago slipper for climbers with narrow feet seeking a precise, glove-like fit.

name: Drago Kid
description: Youth version of the Drago slipper. Designed for young climbers developing technique on overhanging terrain.

name: Furia Air
description: Continues to lead the way in climbing footwear with unmatched sensitivity and lightweight feel. Redesigned V-strap with Differentiated Tension System rand provides dynamic strength for maximum foot flexibility. Ideal for bouldering and both indoor and outdoor climbs.
use_case: Bouldering, indoor climbing, technical sport routes

name: Instinct
description: The iconic Instinct lace offers a precise, high-performance fit for climbers seeking sensitivity and power across a range of climbing styles.

name: Instinct VS
description: Velcro version of the Instinct. Quick-entry closure for gym sessions and multi-pitch routes requiring frequent shoe changes.

name: Instinct VSR
description: The Instinct VSR adds a rubber rand for enhanced durability and performance on overhanging terrain.

name: Instinct VSR LV
description: Low-volume option for the Instinct family. Reduced volume toe box and instep with narrower heel. Features BI-Tension active rand, generous rubber toe patch, and Vibram Grip 2 rubber.

name: Instinct S
description: Slipper version of the Instinct for climbers who prefer a slip-on design with maximum foot sensitivity.

name: Vapor
description: A versatile, do-it-all climbing shoe. Reliable performance for any climbing style with a neutral, flat last.

name: Vapor V / LV
description: Perennial best-seller. The lower volume fit adapts well to narrower feet. Vibram XS Edge rubber underfoot balances support and sensitivity. The quiver-of-one climbing shoe.
use_case: All-around climbing, sport climbing, gym use

name: Vapor S
description: Slipper version of the Vapor. Slip-on design for quick entry with the same reliable Vapor performance.

name: Generator Mid
description: A comfortable, all-day mid-top climbing shoe perfect for multi-pitch routes and crack climbing.

name: Arpia V
description: Velcro closure climbing shoe delivering powerful performance with easy on/off convenience.

name: Arpia V LV
description: Low-volume version of the Arpia V for climbers with narrow feet.

name: Veloce / Veloce L
description: A comfortable, entry-to-intermediate climbing shoe. Lace version (Veloce L) offers a more precise fit. Ideal for gym climbing and moderate outdoor routes.

name: Force
description: An entry-level climbing shoe with a comfortable fit for beginners and gym climbers.

name: Helix
description: The iconic Helix gets a refresh. Full length Vibram sole and extended lacing balance climbing performance and precision with multi-pitch comfort. From gym sessions to all-day trad routes, the versatile Helix will not disappoint.

name: Helix V
description: Expanding on the super-popular Helix lace, the Helix V adds two opposing hook and loop straps for quick and easy yet secure closure. Perfect choice from gym sessions to days at the crag.

name: Origin
description: A comfortable, flat-lasted climbing shoe ideal for beginners and long gym sessions. Lace closure for adjustable fit.

name: Origin VS
description: Comfortable climbing shoe designed for modern indoor bouldering and sport climbing. Dual ply Microsuede upper with comfortable padded tongue and oversized Velcro strap. Massive rubber toe cap, full rubber heel coverage, and super sticky S72 outsole.
use_case: Indoor bouldering, sport climbing, gym sessions

name: Reflex VS
description: Designed with comfort, quality and value in mind. Soft, supple suede upper with stretch-knit instep panel for easy entry, breathability and volume adjustment. Dual microfiber straps for strong, secure closure. Sticky Vision rubber.
use_case: All-day comfort climbing, gym, beginner to intermediate
